ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The eye faculty is the capacity through which visible form is encountered, distinguished in the records from the object seen and from visual consciousness. Masters and compilers examine whether it is identical with seeing, how it returns to the source, and what remains when root, object, and consciousness are cut off.
EvidenceBody: The Source-Mirror Record distinguishes eye faculty, visible object, and visual consciousness, and describes the faculty as freely observing form. Feiyin Tongrong says that leaving even the eye faculty uncut shows the decisive cut has not occurred.

A lamp-record answer says returning to the source through the eye faculty is named Manjusri. Across these uses the faculty is examined as a functional capacity, not reduced to the eyeball or to whatever is seen.

Senses.Note: Seven witnesses cover six-faculty exposition, root-object-consciousness analysis, direct Chan criticism, and return-to-source language.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A standard faculty term is put under direct Chan examination rather than merely listed among six senses.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The entry does not equate the faculty with an anatomical eyeball or settle the arguments raised around it.

ComparedThings: the eye as an anatomical organ
the eye faculty as the capacity involved in seeing
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Selected occurrences consistently participate in root, object, consciousness, or six-faculty analysis; the functional faculty merits its own sense and is not merely the eyeball.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Eye, visual, sight, and sense faculty are needed English access points; ‘eye’ alone would hide the 根 analysis.

ModifierControls.Finding: Root/faculty distinguishes the functional capacity from visible objects and visual consciousness.
The eye specifies the visual member of the six-faculty set; it does not by itself mean insight here.

FamilyControls.Finding: Visual consciousness is explicitly distinguished from the eye faculty and must not be merged.
Visible form/object is the faculty's correlate, not another name for the faculty.
